about.label: About Pak Lee
about.h2: Your Trusted Private Driver in Korea
about.body: I'm Pak Lee, a professional driver with a premium Hyundai Staria Lounge. For Share Tour, I run popular routes regularly — just join a team whose date matches yours, and still enjoy a comfortable private-car experience at a more affordable price.

concept.label: The Concept
concept.title: What is Share Tour?
concept.sub: The concept is simple: the daily rental cost of the Hyundai Staria Lounge is split evenly among teams departing on the same date and route.

cards.title: Why is it Cheaper?
items: One car, multiple teams — fuel, toll and driver cost split evenly
The more teams join (up to 6-7 pax), the cheaper per team
Still one car for everyone — not split across separate cars with strangers

cards.title: What Stays the Same?
items: Same vehicle: premium Hyundai Staria Lounge, not a big bus
Same professional driver as the private tour
Full 10-hour duration to explore the route

concept.note: Share Tour price is for transport and driver only (fuel, insurance, toll included). Attraction entrance tickets are not included and are paid on-site, and the tour only departs once at least 4 people have joined that date.

vehicle.label: Our Vehicle
vehicle.title: Hyundai Staria Lounge
vehicle.body: The same vehicle as the private tour — a premium, VIP-like journey, still comfortable even when shared with another team.
vehicle.footnote: Teams with fewer people get more generous luggage space.

howToBook.label: How to Book
howToBook.title: Easy, Just 3 Steps
howToBook.sub: No account signup or upfront payment needed — everything is coordinated directly with Pak Lee via WhatsApp.

steps.title: Check the Route Calendar
steps.body: Look at the calendar for the route you want — find a green date (confirmed to depart) or a yellow one (still waiting for more people).

steps.title: Contact Pak Lee via WhatsApp
steps.body: Click the Ask Schedule button on the route card, or chat directly — mention your date, route, and team size.

steps.title: Confirm and Deposit
steps.body: Once total participants for that date reach 4, the tour is confirmed to depart. Pay a 30% deposit via Wise, the rest in cash on the day.

wa.ask: Hello Pak Lee! I'm interested in the Share Tour {name}. Could you share more details?
wa.join: Hello Pak Lee! I see a group for Share Tour {route} on {date}. Could you share details and let me join?

cta.h2: Ready to Join a Share Tour?
cta.body: Check the calendar above or chat Pak Lee directly to ask about the latest schedule.
